name: message
description: Lays out a conversation row with optional avatar, header, footer, and start or end alignment.
purpose: Owns chat-row chrome around a bubble so sender, alignment, status, and actions stay consistent in a thread.
bestFor: grouped consecutive messages from one sender
rows with names, delivery status, or actions
avoidFor: standalone alerts that do not sit in a conversation
full scroll containers; pair with a scroller at the page level
